summary: SDK scope: which parts of the TypeScript reference the Python and Go SDKs must match

options.description: RFC-0013 roles stay, plus a core contract that all three match (schemas, resource kinds, metric and telemetry names, compliance ids, audit); judgment, usage, capabilities and design-system are TypeScript-only
Hand-port every reference module to Python and Go
One shared engine used by all three SDKs (needs an RFC)
Freeze the Python and Go SDKs as they are

body: Problem: the Python and Go SDKs had drifted from the TypeScript reference (schemas, resource kinds, metric and telemetry names, compliance ids). RFC-0013 gives each SDK a narrow role (Python: agent runner and policy evaluator; Go: operator and adapters), but nothing said which reference surfaces every SDK must match. Ruling: the RFC-0013 roles stay; schemas, resource kinds, metric and telemetry names, compliance ids and audit match in all three; judgment, usage, capabilities and design-system stay TypeScript-only and are listed as out of role. Tasks: AISDLC-1302 to AISDLC-1311.
